subcohort.evidence_quote: the common restricting (AN-RS) type and the less prevalent binge-eating or purging (AN-BP) type
subcohort.notes: AN subgroup subtypes reported; no explicit subcohort field name used.

target_condition.evidence_quote: Anorexia nervosa (AN) is an eating disorder with a high mortality.

control.evidence_quote: a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females

country.evidence_quote: recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark from 1 September 2014 to 31 July 2016

body_site.evidence_quote: Shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics were performed on faecal and serum samples

days_from_first_collection.notes: Study is cross-sectional; no repeated sampling timepoints reported for human cohort.

westernized.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases, recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark
westernized.notes: Inferred westernized status based on Danish/European setting; not explicitly labeled 'westernized' in text.

antibiotics_exclusion_period.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_exclusion_period.notes: Same exclusion window (3 months) applied to both AN and HC groups (also stated for controls: 'antibiotics within the last 3 months').

antibiotics_exclusion_period_unit.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: DNA extraction from aliquots of faecal samples was performed following IHMS SOP P7 V2
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — Faecal sample collection and DNA extraction
dna_extraction_kit.notes: Protocol (IHMS SOP P7 V2) named rather than a specific commercial kit matching allowed enum values.

ncbi_accession.notes: No SRA/ENA accession numbers reported in the provided text.

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: Purified and amplified DNA fragment libraries were sequenced using the Ion Proton Sequencer (Thermo Fisher)

age.evidence_quote: 77 female AN cases and 70 age-matched female controls
age.notes: Cohorts described as age-matched but exact mean/median age values are only in Supplementary Table 2, not included in provided text.

age_group.evidence_quote: recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark ... Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Unit (Aarhus University Hospital)
age_group.notes: Recruitment sites suggest a mix of adolescent and adult patients; exact age breakdown not given, so specific age_group category not assignable.

ancestry.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases

ancestry_details.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases

sex.evidence_quote: we decided to include only women in the present study

age_min.notes: Only 'age-matched' description given for whole cohort; numeric age ranges are in Supplementary Table 2, not included in provided text. Specific ages for 6 FMT donors are given in samples.

age_max.notes: Same as age_min; whole-cohort numeric age not available in main text.

age_years.notes: Cohort-wide mean age not reported in main text; only individual FMT donor ages reported (see samples).

antibiotics_current_use.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_current_use.notes: Both AN and HC participants were excluded if they used antibiotics within 3 months; inferred that participants were not currently using antibiotics at enrolment.

bmi.evidence_quote: women with AN were much leaner
bmi.section: Results — Phenotypes of women with AN and controls
bmi.notes: Only qualitative statement given for whole cohort; exact BMI values are in Supplementary Table 1/2, not provided in text. Specific BMI values only available for the 6 FMT donors (see samples).

by_subgroup.AN: 40–50% carbohydrate (maximum of 10% sugar), 30–40% fat and 20–25% protein

dietary_restriction.evidence_quote: 40–50% carbohydrate (maximum of 10% sugar), 30–40% fat and 20–25% protein
dietary_restriction.notes: This macronutrient-controlled diet was applied to hospitalized AN patients during treatment; not a dietary restriction reported for HC. Mice were also given a separate 30% energy-restricted diet, not represented here as this schema targets human participants.

disease.evidence_quote: a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females
disease.notes: Study level value left not_reported since disease differs by subgroup; see by_subgroup.

disease_details.evidence_quote: restricting (AN-RS) type and the less prevalent binge-eating or purging (AN-BP) type
disease_details.notes: Two AN subtypes reported; AN-RS n=56, AN-BP n=21 per Fig. 1 legend.

disease_response_orr.notes: Not applicable; no cancer/treatment response data reported.

feces_phenotype.notes: No stool consistency/phenotype (e.g., diarrhea, constipation) reported.

fmt_id.evidence_quote: AN-T n = 10, HC-T, n = 10 examined over 3 independent experiments
fmt_id.notes: These are group-level FMT recipient labels (mouse cohorts), not individual donor identifiers; individual donor IDs not given.

fmt_role.evidence_quote: we transplanted faecal microbiota from three randomly chosen AN-RS cases
fmt_role.section: Results — Gut microbiota induces reduced weight gain and altered energy metabolism in mice
fmt_role.notes: Applies to the 6 human faecal donors (3 AN-RS, 3 HC); mouse recipients (AN-T/HC-T) are not represented in samples since schema targets human participant characteristics.

obgyn_birth_control.evidence_quote: regular medication of any kind apart from birth control pills, and antibiotics within the last 3 months
obgyn_birth_control.notes: This is an exclusion criterion exception (birth control pills allowed) for HC group; does not confirm actual usage by any participant, so left not_reported.

smoker.evidence_quote: confounders including age, smoking and multiple drug intake
smoker.section: Results — Associations between absolute bacterial abundance and bioclinical variables in AN
smoker.notes: Smoking history was recorded/adjusted for as a covariate, but actual smoker/non-smoker status values are not reported in the provided text.

treatment.evidence_quote: Medication included selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors, antipsychotics and benzodiazepines
treatment.notes: Only a subset of AN cases reportedly used these medications (deconfounded as covariates); not stated as a whole-cohort treatment. Outpatients also enrolled in cognitive behavioural therapy.

tumor_staging_ajcc.notes: Not applicable; no cancer staging reported.

biomarker_name.notes: Paper mentions biomarkers like glucose, insulin, HOMA-IR, CRP qualitatively (higher/lower) but does not report specific numeric values with units in the main text; detailed values are in Supplementary Tables not provided.

biomarker_unit.notes: No explicit units reported in provided text for biomarker measurements.

biomarker_value.notes: No explicit numeric biomarker values reported in main text; only qualitative comparisons (e.g., 'lower fasting serum concentrations of glucose and insulin').

disease_response_os.notes: Overall survival not applicable/reported; the paper discusses mortality rate as a general statistic, not per-subject OS data.

ecog_performance_status.notes: ECOG performance status not applicable to this eating disorder study.

feces_phenotype_value.notes: No specific 'feces phenotype' field values reported; fecal microbiome composition described qualitatively across many taxa.

tumor_size_measurement.notes: Not applicable; study is about anorexia nervosa, not tumor pathology.

tumor_size_residual_measurement.notes: Not applicable; no tumor resection data in this study.

uncurated_metadata.notes: Additional context: 77 females with AN and 70 age-matched healthy females; recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark 2014-2016; Danish Caucasian ethnicity; AN subtypes AN-RS (n=56) and AN-BP (n=21); FMT performed to female germ-free Swiss Webster mice.

by_subgroup.mouse_model: Mus musculus (female germ-free Swiss Webster mice)

host_species.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases
host_species.notes: Study includes both human participants (77 AN cases, 70 healthy controls) and a mouse model (Female germ-free Swiss Webster mice) used for faecal microbiota transplantation experiments; schema requires single string so primary human host species reported, with mouse model noted in by_subgroup and notes for completeness.

Sample-level granularity was assigned based on explicit per-individual age and BMI values reported for the 3 AN and 3 HC faecal donors used in FMT experiments; the larger cohort (n=147) itself is only described at aggregate/group level in the main text.
Medication/treatment information (SSRIs, antipsychotics, benzodiazepines) applies only to a subset of AN cases used as deconfounding covariates, not necessarily the entire AN group.

This paper is a multi-omics microbiome study of anorexia nervosa, not a clinical oncology/biomarker trial; most schema fields (biomarker, disease_response_os, ecog_performance_status, tumor_size) are not applicable and were marked not_reported.

The study involves both human subjects and a mouse model (germ-free mice for FMT); host_species field only allows a single string, so 'Homo sapiens' was chosen as primary with mouse details added in notes/by_subgroup.

Detailed biomarker values (e.g., glucose, insulin, CRP, HOMA-IR) are referenced qualitatively (higher/lower) in the main text but exact numeric values are located in Supplementary Tables 1-2, which were not included in the provided text.
